import Base

# One word is one row. `east` reaches zero exactly when the word is complete.
def Life.pack(
  scan: List<&2, U32>, +span: Nat, east: Nat, +bit: U32, row: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match scan east:
    case Nil{} _:
      Nil{}
    case cell <> tail 0n:
      U32.or(row, U32.mul(cell, bit)) <>
        Life.pack(tail, span, Nat.sub(span, 1n), 1, 0)
    case cell <> tail 1n+e:
      Life.pack(
        tail, span, e, U32.shl(bit),
        U32.or(row, U32.mul(cell, bit))
      )

# These three words are the low bitplanes of thirty-two population counts.
# Eight votes wrap eight to zero, so no fourth plane is needed: `twos` and
# not `fours` selects two or three; `ones | alive` chooses S23 from B3.
def Life.quorum(
  votes: List<&2, U32>, alive: U32,
  +ones: U32, +twos: U32, fours: U32
) -> U32:
  match votes:
    case Nil{}:
      U32.and(
        U32.and(twos, U32.not(fours)),
        U32.or(ones, alive)
      )
    case +bits <> rest:
      +carry = U32.and(ones, bits)
      Life.quorum(
        rest, alive,
        U32.xor(ones, bits),
        U32.xor(twos, carry),
        U32.xor(fours, U32.and(twos, carry))
      )

# Three rows become the eight winds around every column simultaneously.
def Life.eight_winds(
  +north: U32, +center: U32, +south: U32
) -> U32:
  Life.quorum(
    [
      U32.shl(north), north, U32.shr(north),
      U32.shl(center),               U32.shr(center),
      U32.shl(south), south, U32.shr(south)
    ],
    center, 0, 0, 0
  )

# Zero above and the appended zero below turn both dead boundaries into data.
def Life.sweep(
  rows: List<&2, U32>, below: List<&2, U32>, above: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows below:
    case Nil{} _:
      Nil{}
    case row <> rest Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case +row <> rest next <> future:
      Life.eight_winds(above, row, next) <>
        Life.sweep(rest, future, row)

# Shifting the head spends one cell; an exhausted row is dropped at east zero.
def Life.unpack(
  fuel: Nat, +span: Nat, rows: List<&2, U32>, east: Nat
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match fuel rows east:
    case 0n _ _:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+f Nil{} _:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+f +row <> rest 0n:
      U32.and(row, 1) <>
        Life.unpack(f, span, rest, Nat.sub(span, 1n))
    case 1n+f +row <> rest 1n+e:
      U32.and(row, 1) <>
        Life.unpack(f, span, U32.shr(row) <> rest, e)

# Packing changes the basis: adjacency becomes shifts and every row evolves
# as thirty-two parallel copies of the same three-bit circuit.
def step(
  +width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +span = U32.to_nat(width)
  +rows = Life.pack(cells, span, Nat.sub(span, 1n), 1, 0)
  Life.unpack(
    U32.to_nat((width * height : U32)),
    span,
    Life.sweep(
      rows,
      List.append(&2, U32, List.tail(&2, U32, rows), [0]),
      0
    ),
    Nat.sub(span, 1n)
  )

# The Nat spine is both the composition count and its termination witness.
def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+more:
      evolve(more, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
hypothesis: Represent each row as one U32 bitset. Horizontal adjacency then becomes shifting, vertical adjacency becomes a three-row stream, and all columns share one bit-sliced population counter. The eight neighbor masks accumulate into `ones`, `twos`, and `fours`; because eight wraps those three planes to zero, B3/S23 is exactly `twos & ~fours & (ones | alive)`. This change of basis should improve conceptual compression, anticipation, and payoff while reducing each generation from repeated whole-board scans to a linear pack/sweep/unpack pipeline.
findings: Confirmed: the round-2 implementation remained behaviorally correct and semantically clean. Confirmed style weakness: the self-inclusive quorum improved payoff, but coordinate comparisons and a full scan per destination cell still presented the mechanism procedurally; `Life.vote`, `Life.sweep`, `step`, and `evolve` all remained below the critical big-brain target, with several anticipation and payoff assessments uncertain. Revised concretely to a bit-parallel row representation: eight shifted neighbor masks feed a three-plane Boolean counter, zero-row sentinels encode the exterior, and packing/unpacking preserve row-major order. No semantic defect was reported.
